flows:
Navigate to https://app.uniswap.org/swap then Do not connect a wallet or sign anything.
On the Uniswap app swap page, click the amount field in the 'Sell' section and type the amount 0.01.
Do not press 'Max', since it needs a connected wallet to fill in a balance.
Never press 'Connect wallet', 'Swap', 'Review', 'Confirm Swap' or 'Approve'.
Assert that the amount 0.01 is visibly shown in the 'Sell' amount field.
